g.text: Full test sets · area = share of spawn events within each benchmark · labels = event counts
Blank cells = zero observed spawns of that member type. A spawn event does not guarantee successful execution.
* Custom profile: the SPAWN event has no template ID; this alone does not establish a new internal graph.
These selected test sets include 20 / 87 / 21 non-template spawns in DROP / MBPP / AutomationBench.
